notes.craft: Thread proposed 2 (2026-10-11): The Kooples names no owned factory, no maker and no mill on its own pages, and none of 337 men's PDPs states a country in the page text. What it does publish is a dated, placed founding (Paris, 2008) and a per-product Fairly Made traceability link required by France's AGEC law, which places the making by country off-page. That is a 2 at best, close to a 1. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.

craft_evidence.mills: none on clothing pages (337 PDPs read)

craft_evidence.process: none: no making process published; ACT (All Committed Together) label on 205/260 styles = at least 60% certified main material or reduced-impact process
craft_evidence.reasoning: The Kooples names no owned factory, no maker and no mill on its own pages, and none of 337 men's PDPs states a country in the page text. What it does publish is a dated, placed founding (Paris, 2008) and a per-product Fairly Made traceability link required by France's AGEC law, which places the making by country off-page. That is a 2 at best, close to a 1.

ownership.owner: Groupe Verdoso (French private investment group, founded 1997 by Franck Ullmann): sole control of The Kooples Production SAS, cleared by the Autorite de la concurrence on 5 March 2025; seller MF Brands (ex-Maus Freres, owner since 2019) per Modaes. Not SMCP/Maje/Sandro and not LVMH-backed.
